description: After gang_buy / gang_sell with handoff: the user's wallet's trades of the token on chain since the handoff, and its balance then and now (read-only). timeout waits for one (up to 30m). Say the trade happened only when traded is true.

from.description: The user's wallet the link was for

since.description: The sinceBlock the handoff printed (not needed on the machine that made it)

timeout.description: Wait up to this long for the trade, e.g. 50s, 5m

name: gang_handoff_status
title: Did the handed-off trade happen?
